name: Astromium Dimensha
author: Maelstrom
description: Fly between the saws and spikes near the ceiling at 69% to skip the robot portal. Navigate through the gameplay until 80% where you can touch the ship portal and then fall to the floor. Move up at 85% to avoid hitting a saw and then move back to the floor at 87% by falling between the saw and spikes. Free to the end from there.
